content:
The image shows a severely withered, dried, and curled twig/shoot — brown, desiccated, with leaves curled and shriveled from the tip downward. There is no white powdery coating (ruling out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty encrustation (ruling out Sooty Mould), and no distinct sunken lesions or spore masses (ruling out Anthracnose). The withering from the base outward, curled dried leaves, and brown discoloration of the twig match Die Back closely.
